name: Relevance
description: Measures how relevant the response is to the context and the previous messages in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response encourages further conversation and interaction.

name: Informational Value
description: Assesses the amount and quality of new information or interesting facts provided in the response.

name: Coherence
description: Measures the logical flow and consistency of the response within the conversation.

name: Originality
description: Evaluates the creativity and uniqueness of the response, avoiding clichés and generic statements.
